name: Contra Job Scraper
description: Checks Contra's For you feed four times a day, files listings into Notion, revisits older leads to see whether they have closed, and emails a formatted digest when there is genuinely something new. Requires a Notion workspace and only covers Contra, not freelance platforms generally.
